meta.title: SERVY Independent Evaluation Manifest
meta.purpose: Document whether an independent evaluation exists

explanation: No genuinely independent evaluation benchmark has been created. All test populations (42-query dev benchmark, 40-case red-team) were designed by the same team that developed the retrieval system. The 42-query benchmark was repeatedly used during model development for hyperparameter tuning, embedding model selection, and reranker training. The 40-case red-team was designed with knowledge of the system's equipment product families and document corpus.
blocked_by: No real company data authorization (MODE A only)
Ollama LLM offline — answer quality untestable
Same team designed both the system and the evaluation
42-query benchmark was used during development (training contamination risk)
No blind held-out evaluation set from unseen document families

42_query_dev_benchmark.reason: Used repeatedly during model development, embedding selection, and reranker training

40_case_redteam.reason: Designed by the same evaluator with knowledge of the system's equipment families and document corpus

requirements_for_independence: 1. External evaluator who has not seen the system code or training data
2. Questions sourced from real customer/technician interactions (requires MODE B authorization)
3. Equipment and document families not used in previous development
5. Blind evaluation with no feedback loop to developers during evaluation
6. Answer quality evaluation (requires Ollama or external LLM)
7. Multi-rater agreement scoring for subjective quality metrics
